text:
Sammy Cho: hey all! just finished onboarding — hi :wave: i'm sammy (they/them). i skateboard to the office and was wondering where people stash boards during the day? also need bagel recs. :skateboard: :baguette_bread:
Mira Sato: welcome sammy!! :confetti_ball: most folks use the rack by the courtyard stairs, otherwise tuck under the standing lockers on 3B. bring a small lock if you can.
People Ops: @Sammy Cho welcome! badge activated. desk 3B-17. DM if you need a monitor or anything else.
Sammy Cho: thanks! when's swag pickup?
Onboard Bot: hi @Sammy Cho — swag pick up today at 4:30pm by reception. bring your badge.
Alex Jensen: lunch crew heads out ~12:15 — today's ramen run. join us?
Sammy Cho: ramen count me in :ramen:
Noel Gomez: fun FYI: someone once labeled a board "property of ops" and it mysteriously became the office mascot's favorite perching spot. proceed with caution :duck: :joy:
Mira Sato: haha. also leave a helmet in your locker — peg hooks near 3B are handy.
Sammy Cho: filled the snack prefs form. who do I bug for a second monitor?
People Ops: we'll coordinate monitors this week; DM if urgent.
Mira Sato: see you at swag pickup and rooftop coffee tomorrow at 10 if you can make it. welcome! :thumbsup:
